jd.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
jd.external_text:
Nordhaven Freight Systems builds the routing and customs software behind roughly 40,000 European road freight shipments a day. Our platform group keeps that running, and we are hiring a senior engineer to take ownership of the shipment ingestion pipeline. Hamburg, hybrid, two days a week in the office.

What you'll do
- Own the ingestion service that receives EDIFACT and API shipment feeds from 120 carriers, and the Kafka topics downstream of it.
- Split the remaining routing logic out of our 2016 Django monolith into the services that already carry 60% of traffic.
- Carry the pager one week in five, with a documented runbook and no expectation of out-of-hours work outside that week.
- Review the work of two mid-level engineers and mentor them through design docs.

Requirements
- 5+ years writing production Python, including something you built and then ran at load.
- Postgres beyond ORM basics: you can read a query plan and explain why a partial index helps.
- Kafka or another log-based broker in production.
- English is our working language; German is useful but not required.

Nice to have
- EDI, customs or freight domain experience.
- Terraform and AWS. Our infrastructure is entirely in eu-central-1.

You would join a team of six engineers plus a product manager, and report to the Head of Platform. Salary is €78,000 - €95,000 depending on experience, with 30 days holiday and a €1,500 annual training budget.
